title: Remote viewer and return behavior verified in automated checks
summary: TypeScript, focused lint, viewer/history/auth tests, 11 native server tests and four browser orientation layouts passed. Android build 18 is being prepared; physical acceptance remains required.

changes.detail: Use a compact safe-area toolbar, collapsible instructions, full available screen height and landscape side controls. Localize native viewer navigation/status in French, English and Arabic.
Resize the existing Android capture surface on rotation; reject gestures from mismatched frame orientation. Avoid clearing each valid frame before replacing it.

Keep approved host pairing encrypted with Android Keystore in no-backup storage; restore after capture restart and revoke through explicit Disconnect, Stop sharing or Forget paired phone. Android capture permission itself is never persisted or bypassed.

Preserve authenticated navigation during background/foreground verification while retaining rejection handling. Save allowlisted app routes without pairing secrets, respect incoming links, and reopen saved direct viewer sessions.
Remove always-expanded viewer instructions and automatic stop-on-rotation behavior.

Correct TypeScript optional path handling and effect-based route references found in initial checks. Confirm direct Disconnect on the host before closing; retain the session for retry if unreachable. Correct viewer asset Unicode text found during screenshot inspection.
Prepare version 1.0.16 / Android build 18, a reproducible build script, an installation/acceptance guide, and synthetic orientation screenshots.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused ESLint
validation.detail: TypeScript and focused ESLint passed after correcting the two initial route-restoration findings. TypeScript passed again after disconnect handling and version preparation.

validation.name: JavaScript regression checks
validation.detail: 19 initial viewer, session, route and history tests passed; 9 owner-session tests passed. The final focused viewer/page/route run passed 12 tests including an added rotation-gesture test and saved connection restoration on page remount.

validation.name: Android native checks
validation.detail: arm64 debug Kotlin/Java compilation and all 11 PhoneDirectServer JVM tests passed, including approval persistence across host restart and explicit revocation. Initial wrapper download was sandbox-blocked; existing cache was used with escalation. Initial default ABI configuration was incompatible with Python 3.14; supported arm64 passed.

validation.name: Browser orientation layout
validation.detail: Headless Edge: four viewer/remote portrait-landscape combinations (360x490 and 780x230 viewer areas; 432x960 and 960x432 synthetic frames). No clipping or overflow, correct proportions, Arabic controls, no browser errors. Screenshots inspected; these are test fixtures, not physical phone captures.

validation.name: Physical acceptance and release
validation.detail: APK packaging is pending. No installation or deployment. Two-phone capture rotation, Keystore storage/reboot, OEM service survival, network changes and Android capture prompts remain untested. Android consent remains mandatory after capture ends. Relay persistence is unchanged.
